note: Domain presets for the prompt engine. 'defaults' fill only fields the user/Claude left empty; they are deliberately specific so no prompt goes out generic. 'keywords' drive domain detection. 'negative' is merged into negative constraints. 'shot_seconds' guides the AI Director's pacing.

general.label: General image / video

defaults.composition: rule-of-thirds composition with a clear focal point and clean negative space
defaults.lighting: soft directional key light from camera left with gentle fill and a subtle rim
defaults.materials: true-to-life textures with fine surface detail
defaults.color: balanced natural color grade with soft contrast

general.motion_default: subtle natural motion in the scene

product.label: Product photography / commercial

defaults.composition: centered hero composition, product filling about 60% of the frame, generous clean negative space for copy
defaults.camera: slightly low three-quarter angle that gives the product presence
defaults.lens: 100mm macro lens, f/8 for edge-to-edge sharpness
defaults.lighting: large softbox key at 45 degrees, strip-light rim tracing the silhouette, white bounce fill, controlled specular highlights
defaults.materials: accurate materials: crisp label print, true metal and glass reflections, micro surface texture
defaults.color: clean neutral grade, true-to-brand colors, deep but not crushed blacks

product.motion_default: highlights glide slowly across the product surface while fine dust motes drift through the key light

architecture.label: Architectural visualization

defaults.composition: two-point perspective, horizon at one third, building occupying the golden section with landscape leading lines
defaults.camera: eye-level camera at 1.6 m, verticals perfectly corrected
defaults.lens: 24mm tilt-shift lens, f/8, straight converging-free verticals
defaults.lighting: golden hour sun low from the west raking across the façade, warm interior lights glowing, soft sky fill
defaults.materials: physically accurate materials: honed travertine, board-formed concrete, bronze-tinted glazing with real reflections, natural timber
defaults.color: warm golden highlights, clean neutral midtones, cool sky gradient, gentle contrast
defaults.environment: landscaped site with native planting, a still reflecting pool and open sky

architecture.motion_default: subtle environmental motion: palm fronds swaying, water rippling in the pool, clouds drifting slowly
preserve_on_reference: camera position and composition of the reference

fashion.label: Fashion / editorial

defaults.composition: full-length or three-quarter figure, strong graphic negative space, model off-center
defaults.camera: slightly low eye-level camera that elongates the figure
defaults.lighting: hard sunlight key with crisp shadows and a white bounce fill, or large beauty dish for studio
defaults.materials: visible fabric weave, drape and sheen, realistic stitching
defaults.color: rich editorial grade with controlled skin tones and a confident accent color
defaults.environment: minimal location with strong architectural lines and clean negative space

fashion.motion_default: confident walk or slow pose transition, fabric moving naturally

character.label: Character / portrait

defaults.composition: medium close-up, eyes on the upper third line, looking slightly off-camera
defaults.lens: 85mm lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field
defaults.lighting: soft key light at 45 degrees with Rembrandt shading, subtle hair light, negative fill on the shadow side
defaults.materials: natural skin texture with visible pores, realistic hair strands, detailed fabric
defaults.color: natural skin tones, soft filmic contrast
defaults.environment: softly defocused environment that reflects the character's world

character.motion_default: subtle natural micro-expressions, blinking and breathing

cinematic.label: Cinematic / film

defaults.composition: widescreen composition with deliberate depth: foreground element, subject in the midground, background detail
defaults.lens: anamorphic 40mm lens, f/2.8, gentle oval bokeh and subtle horizontal flares
defaults.lighting: motivated practical lighting with strong contrast, atmospheric haze catching the light
defaults.materials: tactile, lived-in textures and set dressing
defaults.style: cinematic film still, shot on 35mm film
defaults.color: filmic teal-and-amber grade with rich shadows and soft highlight roll-off, fine film grain
defaults.environment: a lived-in location with layered depth and atmospheric haze

cinematic.motion_default: deliberate motivated camera move with natural character action

ugc.label: UGC / creator-style

defaults.composition: selfie framing, face in the upper third, product held toward the camera in the lower third
defaults.camera: handheld smartphone camera at arm's length, slight natural shake
defaults.lens: smartphone front camera, 26mm-equivalent wide lens, deep focus
defaults.lighting: natural window daylight from the side, a little uneven, real-home ambience
defaults.materials: real home textures: rumpled bedding, kitchen counter clutter kept tidy, real skin texture
defaults.style: authentic user-generated smartphone video, unpolished and believable
defaults.color: natural smartphone color, slightly warm, no cinematic grade
defaults.environment: lived-in bedroom or kitchen at home

ugc.motion_default: talking to camera with natural hand gestures, showing the product to the lens

social.label: Social media short-form

defaults.composition: subject centered inside the platform safe zone, key content and text clear of the caption and UI overlay areas
defaults.camera: dynamic camera with an energetic opening move
defaults.lighting: bright, high-key lighting with clear subject separation
defaults.materials: crisp, high-detail textures that read on a phone screen
defaults.color: vibrant, high-contrast grade that pops on mobile

social.motion_default: immediate motion in the first second to stop the scroll
negative: important content in caption safe zones

concept_art.label: Concept art / environment

defaults.composition: epic wide composition with strong silhouette readability and atmospheric depth layers
defaults.lighting: dramatic volumetric light shafts through atmosphere, strong value grouping
defaults.materials: painterly but believable surfaces with clear material read
defaults.style: high-end cinematic concept art, digital painting
defaults.color: limited cohesive palette with one accent hue guiding the eye
defaults.environment: vast landscape with layered atmospheric depth

concept_art.motion_default: slow atmospheric drift of clouds, fog and particles

automotive.label: Automotive commercial

defaults.composition: low three-quarter front view, car occupying the lower two thirds with the road leading into the frame
defaults.camera: low camera at bumper height mounted on a camera car
defaults.lens: 35mm lens, f/4, slight motion blur on wheels and background
defaults.lighting: low raking sun skimming the bodywork, long specular highlights tracing the body lines, deep reflections of the sky
defaults.materials: deep multi-layer paint with clear-coat reflections, machined alloy wheels, real tyre rubber, glass with accurate reflections
defaults.color: rich contrast, deep blacks, glossy highlights, cool shadows against warm sunlight
defaults.environment: sweeping open road through dramatic landscape

automotive.motion_default: the car glides forward with wheels turning, reflections sliding across the bodywork

food.label: Food & beverage

defaults.composition: tight 45-degree hero angle, dish filling the frame with a shallow foreground prop
defaults.camera: 45-degree high angle, or flat lay for spreads
defaults.lens: 100mm macro lens, f/4, creamy background falloff
defaults.lighting: soft backlight from a window behind the food for glow and translucency, white bounce fill in front, small specular kick on moist surfaces
defaults.materials: glistening sauces, crisp textures, visible steam, condensation droplets on cold glass, fresh herbs
defaults.color: warm appetizing grade, saturated but natural food colours
defaults.environment: rustic tabletop with linen and ceramic props

food.motion_default: steam rises slowly, a sauce drizzles in a thin ribbon, garnish falls in slow motion
